Reuse the selected neutral shell, restrained exact green #0B7A3E and yellow #F2D11F, modern sans typography, fine line icons and consistent controls. No green sidebar, dashboard filler, fake charts or invented product functionality. Accessible focus, well-labelled forms, clear table hierarchy, refined dialogs. Reference designs only; certified handlers will remain the implementation authority.
